fingerprint.description: Source-tree fingerprint. One line per input file: '<content hash>  <relative path>\n', lines sorted by byte order; the fingerprint is the sha256 of those lines. Content hashes follow the hashing rule below. Shared by scripts/release/artifact-lib.mjs and scripts/release/lib.php.

hashing.rule: Text files hash their LF-normalised bytes, so a Windows checkout (CRLF working copy) and a cPanel checkout (LF blobs) agree. Files whose extension is listed in binaryExtensions hash their raw bytes.
